summary: REQ-34 requires the Premium subscription tier on SubscriptionPackagesPage to display 'Unlimited Sessions' as a key benefit, while Basic and Standard tiers continue showing fixed session counts. The diff evidence shows these changes were implemented: the Premium package uses sessionsPerMonth=9999 as a sentinel for unlimited, 'Unlimited sessions/month' was added to its features list, an Infinity icon and 'Unlimited Sessions' label were added to the Premium card, Basic and Standard retain fixed session counts, and an isUnlimited() helper was added. All acceptance criteria appear to be addressed.
